newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells extra 3.26 bln Ffr of BTANs.
newsitem.headline: France sells extra 3.26 bln Ffr of BTANs.

text.p: The Treasury said on Friday it sold a further 3.261 billion francs of BTANs after Thursday's auction, increasing the total value of bonds sold to 25.809 billion. Following are the final sale details.

NOTE - The Treasury originally announced it would sell 21 to 23 billion francs of BTANs in total. The total bid cover ratio of the auction was 2.95.

Under the French system, primary dealers and central banks not only submit competitive bids at the auction, but also have the option, for a limited period after the sale, of buying extra bonds at the average auction price.
